figures.label: Standard OPT Duration
figures.source: Every eligible F-1 graduate gets 12 months of standard post-completion OPT. If your degree is on the official STEM Designated Degree Program List and your employer is enrolled in E-Verify, you can apply for a further 24-month STEM OPT extension, taking your total work authorization to up to 36 months. Non-STEM graduates are capped at the 12-month window with no extension option.

items.text: Initial 12-month OPT: a maximum of 90 days of unemployment across the full period.
Be actively enrolled in E-Verify and remain in good standing with the program for the length of your STEM OPT employment.
Complete and sign Form I-983, a structured training plan describing the specific goals, skills, and supervision you will receive.
Report material changes, such as a change in your role, supervisor, or worksite, within the required timeframe.
Conduct periodic self-evaluations with you as part of the I-983 training plan, typically at the midpoint and end of the extension.

blocks.heading: Re-Register the Following Cycle If OPT Time

items.text: Check cap-exempt employers: universities, affiliated nonprofit research organizations, and certain government research roles can sponsor H1B petitions outside the annual lottery cap entirely.

Look at O-1 eligibility if your profile is genuinely exceptional: strong publication records, notable awards, or clear evidence of extraordinary ability in your field can qualify for an O-1 visa, though the bar is high and evidence-heavy.

Consider a further degree that restarts F-1 status: enrolling in another qualifying academic program is a legitimate way to extend your stay and try the lottery again later, though this should be a genuine academic step, not a paperwork move alone.

Treat a return to India as a real plan, not a failure state: the skill portfolio, project experience, and international exposure you built on OPT carry real value in the Indian job market, see return to India after MS abroad for how to time and position that move well.
